title: SwiReasoning: Switch-Thinking in Latent and Explicit for Pareto-Superior Reasoning LLMs

rs.key_step: 根据token entropy相对block起点的变化切换显式/latent reasoning；对L→E切换计数并注入结束信号。
rs.why_non_obvious: 把模式与停止时机变成推理过程自由度，但entropy是置信代理而非正确性证明。
rs.trigger_condition: When latent exploration diffuses and explicit thinking overcommits, switch modes using local uncertainty trends and cap completed blocks.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When latent exploration diffuses and explicit thinking overcommits, switch modes using local uncertainty trends and cap completed blocks.

signatures.operation: latent用分布加权embedding，H下降转explicit，H上升且dwell满足转latent；switch cap触发answer
signatures.failure_boundary: 不是RL或真实视觉信息获取，entropy趋势可能与正确性错位；较强结束干预可严重掉点。

relevance.how: 按block状态停止的控制结构可迁移，但需验证crop真实收益。
entropy阈值不代表校准后的正确率。
